gaps.sentence: Only after the third attempt ___ she pass the test.
gaps.explanation: 'Only after' at the front forces question word order: did she pass.

gaps.sentence: ___ it not for your quick thinking, the whole project would have failed.
gaps.explanation: 'Were it not for …' = 'If it were not for …' — formal inverted conditional.

gaps.sentence: So convincing ___ his argument that nobody objected.
gaps.explanation: So + adjective at the front: was his argument that…

gaps.sentence: Only after the third reminder ___ she reply to my email.
gaps.explanation: 'Only after' fronts the condition, so 'did she reply' inverts.

gaps.sentence: Nowhere ___ you find a better example of Gothic architecture.
___ had I hung up than the phone rang again.
gaps.explanation: 'No sooner had I hung up than …' — the fixed inverted pair.

gaps.sentence: Should the temperature ___ 40 degrees, the system shuts down.
gaps.explanation: Should the temperature exceed… = if it exceeds… — technical register.

gaps.sentence: Only when the last guest had left ___ she sit down.
gaps.explanation: 'Only when … had left did she sit down' — inverted past simple.
